research_situations: a declared active estimate must be persisted as a .ster artifact before a later consumer
selection_conditions: an active compatible e-class estimate exists
the durable .ster path and later consumer are declared
required_changes: replace model content and declared .ster path only
tradeoffs: separates durable estimate state from any table export
does not select which estimate is substantively retained
reusable_core: 활성 추정결과를 .ster로 저장한 뒤 별도 consumer 직전에 다시 attach한다.
generality_rationale_ko: .ster 영속 상태와 in-memory store/restore는 서로 다른 lifecycle이므로 분리한다.
variant_distinction: [ster_seed_then_use] durable .ster seed plus explicit reattachment
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. .ster 파일명과 보존할 사양은 연구자가 선언하며, 감사 전 자동 선택하지 않는다.

research_situations: an ordered set of declared in-memory estimates must be retained for a later table consumer
selection_conditions: each active e-class result is declared
names and model order are declared
required_changes: replace models and explicit estimate names only
tradeoffs: keeps ordering inspectable
does not persist across a fresh Stata session

template_input_profile.record_unit: one active e-class result per declared specification

reusable_core: 각 활성 e-class 결과를 명시적 순서의 named estimate로 저장한다.
generality_rationale_ko: .ster 파일 저장과 달리 세션 내 ordered store state만 생산한다.
variant_distinction: [numbered_in_memory_store] ordered in-memory stores rather than durable .ster persistence
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. numbered name은 연구 사양 순서를 숨기지 않는 선언일 때만 사용하며 감사 전 자동 선택하지 않는다.

research_situations: a declared named estimate must become the active e-class result before a compatible consumer
selection_conditions: the named estimate exists in memory
the immediate consumer is declared
required_changes: replace named estimate only
tradeoffs: makes active-state handoff explicit
does not load an absent .ster file
reusable_core: 명시한 named estimate를 active e-class 상태로 복원한다.
generality_rationale_ko: restore는 저장·파일 attach와 달리 in-memory result 재활성화만 수행한다.
variant_distinction: [restore_named_active_estimate] named in-memory estimate restore
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. 복원 대상과 consumer compatibility는 별도 감사 대상이다.

research_situations: declared groups need descriptive N, mean, and SD in a visible statistics layout
selection_conditions: numeric variables and group definition are declared
the descriptive statistic set is declared
required_changes: replace variables, grouping key, and declared statistic list only
tradeoffs: preserves group and statistic dimensions
does not choose the group definition

template_input_profile.record_unit: one observation assigned to one declared group

reusable_core: 선언한 group별로 N·mean·SD를 명시적 tabstat layout으로 계산한다.
generality_rationale_ko: grouped statistics layout은 ungrouped/weighted tabstat과 다른 입력 상태를 가진다.
variant_distinction: [tabstat_by_declared_statistics] grouped statistics layout
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. descriptive group 의미와 표본은 연구자가 선언한다.

research_situations: a declared analytic-weighted descriptive aggregation is required
selection_conditions: numeric variables and valid analytic weight are declared
weight type is substantively approved
required_changes: replace variables, weight, and declared statistics only
tradeoffs: makes weighting explicit
does not infer the appropriate weight type
reusable_core: 선언한 analytic weight로 tabstat descriptive statistics를 계산한다.
generality_rationale_ko: weight type는 결과 의미를 바꾸므로 unweighted tabstat과 별도 variant다.
variant_distinction: [tabstat_declared_analytic_weight] analytic-weighted statistics
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. weight type·정당성은 guide가 공급하지 않으며 감사 전 자동 선택하지 않는다.

research_situations: a declared group produces one repeated scatter panel per group
selection_conditions: x, y, group, and graph purpose are declared
required_changes: replace x, y, group, and declared presentation options only
tradeoffs: keeps panel grouping visible
does not choose grouping or visual interpretation

template_input_profile.record_unit: one observation assigned to one graph panel

reusable_core: 선언한 group마다 twoway scatter panel을 만든다.
generality_rationale_ko: by-panel graph는 단일 series graph와 panel grouping 상태가 materially different하다.
variant_distinction: [twoway_scatter_by_declared_group] twoway by-panel construction
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. group choice·axis·interpretation은 별도 연구 결정이다.

research_situations: declared saved graphs must be assembled into one PDF figure
selection_conditions: all .gph inputs, layout, and PDF path are declared
required_changes: replace graph paths, layout, and PDF path only
tradeoffs: separates graph assembly from construction
does not choose graph order or layout

template_input_profile.source_basis: Stata graph combine and export manual mechanics

reusable_core: 선언된 .gph를 combine하고 active graph를 PDF로 즉시 내보낸다.
generality_rationale_ko: combined graph persistence는 active graph PDF export와 다른 multi-artifact producer state다.
variant_distinction: [combine_declared_gph_then_pdf] combine saved graphs before PDF export
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. graph order/layout은 research-facing presentation decision이므로 guide가 정하지 않는다.

research_situations: one declared flat outcome list requires immediate one-PDF-per-graph persistence
selection_conditions: one flat declared list, graph recipe, and output naming rule are approved
no hidden sample or specification choice is encoded in the loop
required_changes: replace declared outcome list, graph bindings, and PDF naming rule only
tradeoffs: limits active loop depth to one and makes output timing visible
does not decide outcomes or graph model

template_input_profile.record_unit: one observation for each declared graph outcome
template_input_profile.source_basis: Stata foreach and graph export manual mechanics

reusable_core: 한 단계 flat loop에서 그래프를 만든 직후 각 PDF를 저장한다.
generality_rationale_ko: loop 내부 immediate export는 later graph combine/state overwrite risk와 다르므로 별도 variant다.
variant_distinction: [flat_loop_construct_then_pdf] flat loop with immediate per-item PDF export
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. active loop depth는 1이며, declared list 밖의 research choice를 loop에 직렬화하지 않는다.

research_situations: two or more declared outcomes require ordered native outreg2 Excel columns
selection_conditions: outcome order, model specification, inference, and common table schema are declared
required_changes: replace declared outcomes, regressors, cluster, titles, and Excel path only
tradeoffs: makes seed/append and outcome order explicit
does not establish comparability of outcome scales or samples

produces: ordered native Excel columns with raw e(b) identities

template_input_profile.record_unit: one estimation observation per declared outcome
variable_characteristics: native e(b) coefficient and omitted/base identities

reusable_core: 선언한 outcome 순서대로 첫 outreg2 Excel 열은 replace, 후속 열은 append로 기록한다.
generality_rationale_ko: multi-outcome column ordering은 단일 sheet seed/append보다 추가된 estimate-order contract를 가진다.
variant_distinction: [ordered_multioutcome_replace_append] ordered multi-outcome native outreg2 assembly
review_notes: maintainer-guide base mechanics 후보다. raw coefficient와 omitted/base rows는 native e(b) identity로 보존하며 수동 coefficient bridge는 금지한다.

research_situations: a declared multi-sheet Excel placement is needed after a native outreg2 seed artifact exists
selection_conditions: workbook owner, sheet name, formatter availability, and source table state are declared
required_changes: replace seed path and declared sheet placement only
tradeoffs: keeps a formatter distinct from table estimation/export
guide evidence for outreg2_xlsx sheet mechanics is incomplete

template_input_profile.source_basis: outreg2 maintainer guide base mechanics plus bounded formatter reference

reusable_core: native outreg2 Excel seed 뒤에 declared sheet formatter handoff를 reference로만 둔다.
generality_rationale_ko: multi-sheet placement는 outreg2 command 자체의 replace/append file-state와 다른 formatter interface를 가진다.
variant_distinction: [outreg2_xlsx_declared_sheet_reference] multi-sheet formatter reference after native outreg2 seed
review_notes: maintainer-guide base mechanics 후보다. outreg2 guide가 outreg2_xlsx의 multi-sheet API를 충분히 보장하지 않으므로 audit/runtime 전에는 reference-only이며 자동 선택 금지다.

research_situations: a declared IV first stage saved by ivreg2 must be restored before native Excel output
selection_conditions: endogenous variable, instrument, IV estimator, first-stage naming, and table path are declared
required_changes: replace IV variables, cluster, saved-first-stage prefix, title, and Excel path only
tradeoffs: keeps first-stage state handoff explicit
does not establish weak-IV diagnostics or causal identification

template_input_profile.source_basis: ivreg2 and outreg2 maintainer guide mechanics

reusable_core: ivreg2가 명시적으로 저장한 first stage를 restore한 뒤 outreg2로 native Excel 결과를 기록한다.
generality_rationale_ko: IV first-stage restore/handoff는 일반 active estimate outreg2와 estimator state가 materially different하다.
variant_distinction: [saved_first_stage_restore_native_excel] saved IV first-stage restore before native outreg2 export
review_notes: maintainer-guide base mechanics 후보다. raw first-stage coefficient/omitted rows를 수동 재구성하지 않으며 IV identification·weak-IV 해석은 guide가 공급하지 않는다.

research_situations: one declared event-study estimate needs a graph with automatic axis range
selection_conditions: active event estimate and native factor-variable coefficient selector are declared
automatic axis range is requested
required_changes: replace only the declared native coefficient selector and presentation bindings
tradeoffs: uses native e(b) identities
does not set a fixed event window

produces: single-series active event graph with automatic axis

required_keys: declared raw e(b) event coefficient identities

reusable_core: 한 active event estimate의 native factor-variable coefficient만 coefplot으로 그리고 axis는 자동으로 둔다.
generality_rationale_ko: single event auto-axis는 multi-estimate/fixed-axis event graph와 cardinality·axis state가 다르다.
variant_distinction: [single_event_auto_axis] one event estimate with automatic axis
review_notes: maintainer-guide base mechanics 후보다. manual event dummy를 만들지 않고 raw e(b) selector를 유지하며 감사 전 자동 선택하지 않는다.

research_situations: two declared event-study estimates need separate plotted series with automatic axis range
selection_conditions: each named event estimate and shared native coefficient selector are declared
automatic axis range is requested
required_changes: replace estimate names, labels, and native selector only
tradeoffs: keeps named series separate
does not establish comparability across specifications

requires: two or more named compatible event estimates
produces: multi-series active event graph with automatic axis

template_input_profile.record_unit: one native event coefficient per declared estimate

reusable_core: 명시된 여러 event estimate를 native coefficient selector로 separate series로 그린다.
generality_rationale_ko: multiple series cardinality는 single event auto-axis와 materially different하여 별도 variant다.
variant_distinction: [multiple_event_auto_axis] multiple named event estimates with automatic axis
review_notes: maintainer-guide base mechanics 후보다. series comparability와 labels는 연구자가 선언하며 raw e(b) identity를 바꾸지 않는다.

research_situations: a declared event-study window requires a fixed displayed axis
selection_conditions: active compatible event estimate, native selector, and fixed event window are declared
required_changes: replace native selector and declared fixed axis only
tradeoffs: makes display range explicit
does not derive the valid event window from coefficient names

produces: event graph with declared fixed axis

reusable_core: native event coefficient를 그리되 declared fixed event window를 xlabel에 명시한다.
generality_rationale_ko: fixed axis는 automatic axis와 다른 display-state contract이므로 별도 variant다.
variant_distinction: [event_declared_fixed_axis] event graph with declared fixed axis
review_notes: maintainer-guide base mechanics 후보다. event window choice는 substantive reporting decision이며 automatic-axis variant로 대체하지 않는다.

research_situations: declared linear-scale and exponentiated-scale estimates are inspected together only after scale comparability is justified
selection_conditions: each named estimate, coefficient, scale, and comparison rationale are declared
required_changes: replace estimate names, scale option, coefficient selector, and labels only
tradeoffs: keeps scale transform visible
mixed-scale comparison can be misleading and is never auto-selected

template_input_profile.record_unit: one coefficient from each declared model family
variable_characteristics: coefficient scales requiring explicit comparison rationale

reusable_core: mixed model family plot mechanics를 scale caveat와 함께 reference-only로 남긴다.
generality_rationale_ko: linear coefficient와 odds ratio는 scale comparability risk가 있어 single-family coefficient plot과 분리한다.
variant_distinction: [mixed_family_comparison_reference] mixed model-family comparison with visible scale transform
review_notes: maintainer-guide base mechanics 후보다. mixed scale의 interpretability가 별도 승인되지 않으면 reference로만 유지하며 selector는 차단한다.

research_situations: researcher-declared nondefault tail cuts must produce new capped variables
selection_conditions: variables, cut values, pooled scope, and suffix are explicitly declared
required_changes: replace variables, declared cut values, and suffix only
tradeoffs: preserves source variables by creating new variables
does not choose cut values or justify outlier treatment
reusable_core: 명시한 nondefault cutpoint로 원변수는 보존하고 새 winsorized variable을 만든다.
generality_rationale_ko: arbitrary declared cuts는 default tail, by-group, in-place replace와 separate outlier contract다.
variant_distinction: [pooled_nondefault_cuts_new_variables] pooled nondefault declared cuts to new variables
review_notes: maintainer-guide base mechanics 후보다. tail cut은 researcher decision이고 generated variable의 정의·label은 consumer workflow에서 명시해야 한다.

research_situations: declared stored estimates must be assembled by etable without manual coefficient transfer
selection_conditions: each stored estimate and desired table order are declared
required_changes: replace stored estimate names and approved display options only
tradeoffs: retains native results collection
does not choose models or reporting statistics
reusable_core: 명시된 stored estimate를 etable의 active collection으로 조립한다.
generality_rationale_ko: etable consumer state는 outreg2 Excel export와 다른 Stata collection workflow다.
variant_distinction: [etable_declared_stored_estimates] etable from declared stored estimates
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. 수동 coefficient/SE bridge를 만들지 않으며 estimates/ordering choice는 별도 선언한다.

research_situations: an active declared collection requires a bounded numeric/header layout style before export
selection_conditions: active collection and required layout fields are declared
required_changes: replace result cells, number format, and declared header visibility only
tradeoffs: keeps presentation state in the collection
does not select substantive table contents
reusable_core: active collection의 declared result cell과 header layout을 style command로 설정한다.
generality_rationale_ko: collection styling은 result assembly/export와 구분되는 presentation-state transition이다.
variant_distinction: [collect_declared_style_layout] active collection style/layout
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. format precision·header visibility는 reader-facing reporting choice로 선언된 값만 대체한다.

research_situations: a declared active collection must be persisted directly to one Excel workbook
selection_conditions: active collection and Excel destination ownership are declared
required_changes: replace Excel path and declared replace policy only
tradeoffs: exports native collection state without a manual bridge
does not manage multi-sheet placement automatically
reusable_core: active collection을 declared Excel workbook으로 직접 export한다.
generality_rationale_ko: collect export는 etable assembly/style과 달리 final artifact persistence state만 담당한다.
variant_distinction: [collect_active_to_declared_xlsx] active collection direct Excel export
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. workbook ownership과 sheet policy는 외부 contract로 선언되어야 하며 Excel export만 사용한다.

research_situations: a declared in-memory estimate must survive an intervening active estimate and then be explicitly restored
selection_conditions: both estimates and their ordered roles are declared
the restored estimate has a declared immediate consumer
required_changes: replace both declared models and the stored estimate name only
tradeoffs: proves a real store/restore lifecycle rather than a no-op restore
does not persist beyond the current Stata session

requires: a distinct intervening active e-class estimate

template_input_profile.record_unit: one active e-class result per declared specification

reusable_core: 첫 active result를 store한 뒤 다른 active result로 바꾸고 named result를 restore한다.
generality_rationale_ko: 실제 active-state 변경을 포함해 단순 store 또는 단독 restore와 다른 paired lifecycle을 보인다.
variant_distinction: [store_change_active_then_restore] paired in-memory store, active-state change, then restore
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. named result의 substantive role과 consumer compatibility는 guide가 정하지 않으며 감사 전 자동 선택하지 않는다.

research_situations: one declared active e-class estimate must create an etable collection without selecting stored estimates
selection_conditions: one active compatible e-class estimate exists
a stored-estimates comparison is not requested
required_changes: replace the active model and approved display options only
tradeoffs: consumes the current active estimation state directly
does not collect multiple stored estimates

produces: active etable collection from current e-class result

reusable_core: 현재 active e-class estimate만 etable collection으로 만든다.
generality_rationale_ko: stored estimates() option을 쓰는 etable과 달리 one active estimate state를 직접 소비한다.
variant_distinction: [etable_active_eclass_no_estimates_option] active e-class etable without estimates() option
review_notes: 공식 매뉴얼 mechanics 후보다. stored-estimate etable variant와 합치지 않으며, active estimate의 substantive choice는 별도 contract로 선언한다.
